name: vygolint
description: Conformance evaluation of educational games against 43 socio-interactionist criteria, with levels A, AA and AAA

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate educational games against Vygotskian design guidelines
interface.longDescription: Use vygolint to evaluate an educational game from its code, design documents and gameplay video against 43 testable criteria derived from the 40 guidelines of Carvalho (2020), producing a conformance report with levels A, AA and AAA and recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate this educational game with vygolint.
Does this game meet criterion D17.1?
